run_supernet_training: run the Trainer to train a one-shot LaNAS supernet on CIFAR-10 for 300 epochs
train_supernet_with_custom_params: create a Trainer with custom batch_size, init_channels, and epochs then call run to train
define_nas_search_space: call define_search_space to build the linear constraint matrices A and b for NAS architecture search
encode_supernet_architecture: call encode_supernet to flatten the normal and reduce cell supernet into a 1D vector of parameters
run_mcts_nas_search: instantiate MCTS with a search_space and Trainer then call search to perform Monte Carlo Tree Search over architectures
